# laravel_cloud_environment (Resource)

Manages a Laravel Cloud environment.

~> **Beta:** This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravel_cloud_application" "example" {
  name                         = "my-app"
  repository                   = "my-org/my-app"
  region                       = "us-east-2"
  source_control_provider_type = "github"
}

resource "laravel_cloud_database_cluster" "example" {
  name    = "my-app-db"
  type    = "laravel_mysql"
  version = "8.4"
  region  = "us-east-2"
  config = jsonencode({
    size                     = "mysql-flex-1gb"
    storage                  = 10
    is_public                = false
    uses_scheduled_snapshots = true
    retention_days           = 7
  })
}

resource "laravel_cloud_database" "production" {
  cluster_id = laravel_cloud_database_cluster.example.id
  name       = "my_app"
}

resource "laravel_cloud_cache" "example" {
  name                 = "my-app-cache"
  type                 = "laravel_valkey"
  region               = "us-east-2"
  size                 = "valkey-flex-250mb"
  auto_upgrade_enabled = true
  is_public            = false
}

# Laravel Cloud creates the application's "production" environment with the
# application, so this takes it over instead of creating another.
resource "laravel_cloud_environment" "production" {
  application_id = laravel_cloud_application.example.id
  name           = "production"
  branch         = "main"

  php_version  = "8.4:1"
  node_version = "22"

  build_command  = "composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && npm ci && npm run build"
  deploy_command = "php artisan migrate --force"

  uses_push_to_deploy = true
  timeout             = 30 # seconds

  database_id = laravel_cloud_database.production.id
  cache_id    = laravel_cloud_cache.example.id

  response_headers_frame        = "sameorigin"
  response_headers_hsts_max_age = 31536000
}

# A staging environment that deploys the develop branch and asks search
# engines not to index it.
resource "laravel_cloud_environment" "staging" {
  application_id = laravel_cloud_application.example.id
  name           = "staging"
  branch         = "develop"
  php_version    = "8.4:1"
  color          = "orange"

  uses_push_to_deploy = true

  response_headers_robots_tag = "noindex, nofollow"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Parent application ID.
- `branch` (String) Git branch.
- `name` (String) Environment name (1-40 characters).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `build_command` (String) Custom build command (max 2000 chars). Leave unset to keep the framework's default, or for a static site to build nothing.
- `cache_id` (String) Cache to attach. Removing it detaches the cache. A detach or another cache attached outside Terraform shows in the next plan; left unset, the attachment is not managed.
- `cache_strategy` (String) Cache strategy (default, bypass).
- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the dedicated cluster the environment runs on; null on shared compute. Leave unset to keep where the environment runs. An environment cannot move, so a different cluster replaces it.
- `color` (String) Environment color (blue, green, orange, purple, red, yellow, cyan, gray). Leave unset to keep the color Laravel Cloud picked when it created the environment.
- `database_id` (String) ID of the database to attach (a laravel_cloud_database, not its cluster). Removing it detaches the database. A detach or another database attached outside Terraform shows in the next plan; left unset, the attachment is not managed.
- `database_schema_id` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated alias for database_id.
- `deploy_command` (String) Custom deploy command (max 2000 chars).
- `edge_network_id` (String) Dedicated edge network to create the environment in (see the laravel_cloud_edge_networks data source). Only for organizations with a dedicated edge network. The API never reports it back, so the first plan after an import shows it being added; applying that plan only records the value.
- `filesystem_keys` (Attributes List) Object storage buckets attached to the environment, each through one of its access keys and under a disk name. This list replaces every attachment: an empty list detaches all buckets, and so does removing the attribute once set. Write-only: the API never reports the attachments back, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filesystem_keys))
- `firewall_block_path` (Boolean) Whether the firewall blocks requests for common exploit paths.
- `firewall_browser_integrity_check` (Boolean) Whether the firewall runs a browser integrity check on requests.
- `hibernation_wake_up_interval` (Number) Minutes between periodic wake-ups of a hibernating environment (1-10080, up to 7 days). Set 0 to turn periodic wake-ups off.
- `nightwatch_token` (String, Sensitive) Nightwatch environment token (44 chars) that connects the environment to Nightwatch. Removing it disconnects Nightwatch. The API never reports it back, so a token changed outside Terraform is not detected. It is stored in Terraform state; with Terraform 1.11 or later, use nightwatch_token_wo instead to keep it out of state.
- `nightwatch_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Nightwatch environment token as a write-only argument (Terraform 1.11 or later): it is sent and never stored in plan or state. Because Terraform cannot see it change, it is sent only on create and when nightwatch_token_wo_version changes; bump the version to rotate it. Removing both disconnects Nightwatch.
- `nightwatch_token_wo_version` (Number) Version of nightwatch_token_wo. Changing it sends the current nightwatch_token_wo.
- `node_version` (String) Node.js version.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version to run, in the API's "major:minor" form (such as "8.4:1"). The API reports only the major version (see php_major_version), so an import derives this from it. A version changed outside Terraform is not detected.
- `post_deploy_command` (String) Commands that run after a deployment goes live, one per line, such as "php artisan queue:restart" (max 2000 chars). A failure does not roll the deployment back. Only organizations with post-deploy commands enabled can set it, and not on preview or static environments; where Laravel Cloud does not offer it, the plan warns and the apply fails. Null when not reported.
- `response_headers_content_type` (String) X-Content-Type-Options response header: nosniff or none.
- `response_headers_frame` (String) X-Frame-Options response header: deny, sameorigin or all.
- `response_headers_hsts_include_subdomains` (Boolean) Whether HSTS also covers subdomains.
- `response_headers_hsts_max_age` (Number) Strict-Transport-Security max-age in seconds; 0 turns HSTS off. Null when HSTS was never set. Required when include_subdomains or preload is true.
- `response_headers_hsts_preload` (Boolean) Whether the HSTS header asks for preloading. Needs include_subdomains and a max_age of at least 31536000.
- `response_headers_robots_tag` (String) X-Robots-Tag response header: "index, follow" or "noindex, nofollow".
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the environment is running. Set false to stop it, which cancels a deployment in progress, and true to start it again, which deploys the latest commit; Terraform waits for that deployment to succeed. Only an environment that has been deployed can be stopped. Leave unset to leave it as it is.
- `serving_mode` (String) How the environment is served: "process" (an application server) or "static" (files served directly, for a static site). Leave unset to let Laravel Cloud decide: a new environment of an application that already has a static environment is static too. It cannot be changed after creation, so changing it forces a new environment. Null when the API does not report it.
- `serving_root` (String) Directory a static environment serves, relative to the repository ("." for the top level). Only static environments accept it.
- `shutdown_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait before stopping the previous deployment's instances, so they can finish their requests and jobs (1-600). Applies on the next deployment. Leave unset to keep the platform default.
- `sleep_timeout` (Number, Deprecated) Minutes without requests before the environment hibernates (1-60). Only instance sizes that can hibernate (Flex) take it: on a Pro size Laravel Cloud turns hibernation off instead, and the apply fails. The API reports whether hibernation is on but not this value, so hibernation turned off outside Terraform shows in the next plan, and a changed value does not. It is the same setting as the app instance's hibernation_timeout (laravel_cloud_instance), so set it in only one place. The API cannot turn hibernation off through the environment; use the instance for that. Deprecated: use hibernation_timeout on a laravel_cloud_instance with type = "app".
- `slug` (String)
- `start_command` (String) Command that starts a dynamic application that is not PHP, such as "gunicorn myproject.wsgi" (max 255 chars). Required by the API for dynamic JavaScript, Python, Ruby, Go, Rust and Java applications, and rejected for PHP and static ones.
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds the environment waits for the application to respond before timing out (5-60). Applies on the next deployment. Leave unset to keep the platform default.
- `uses_deploy_hook` (Boolean)
- `uses_octane` (Boolean)
- `uses_purge_edge_cache_on_deploy` (Boolean) Whether a deploy purges the edge cache. Write-only: the API accepts this but never reports it back, so drift cannot be detected.
- `uses_push_to_deploy` (Boolean)
- `uses_vanity_domain` (Boolean)
- `vanity_domain` (String) Subdomain label of the environment's vanity domain, such as "my-app" for my-app.laravel.cloud: 3 to 63 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, not starting or ending with a dash. The full hostname is in vanity_hostname. Leave unset to keep the assigned default. The API allows one change every 30 minutes.
- `websocket_application_id` (String) WebSocket application (laravel_cloud_websocket_application) to attach. Removing it detaches the application. A detach or another application attached outside Terraform shows in the next plan; left unset, the attachment is not managed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_from_automation` (Boolean) Whether the environment is a preview environment created for a pull request.
- `deploy_hook_url` (String, Sensitive) URL that deploys the environment when it receives a POST request, such as from CI. Null while uses_deploy_hook is false, or when the API token lacks permission to edit deploy hooks. Anyone with the URL can deploy.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the dashboard: the name, or a preview environment's pull request title.
- `framework` (String) Framework Laravel Cloud detected in the branch (such as laravel, nextjs).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `language` (String) Language of the environment (such as php, javascript).
- `php_major_version` (String) Major PHP version reported by the API (such as "8.4").
- `pull_request` (Attributes) The pull request a preview environment deploys. Null for other environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pull_request))
- `status` (String) Current environment status.
- `uses_hibernation` (Boolean) Whether the environment hibernates when idle. Set it with hibernation_timeout on the app instance (laravel_cloud_instance with type = "app"), which also turns it off, or the deprecated sleep_timeout here.
- `vanity_hostname` (String) Full vanity domain hostname, such as "my-app.laravel.cloud".

<a id="nestedatt--filesystem_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filesystem_keys`

Required:

- `disk` (String) Disk name the bucket is exposed as (1-40 chars: letters, numbers, spaces, dashes and underscores).
- `key_id` (String) ID of the bucket access key (laravel_cloud_storage_bucket_key) to attach the bucket with.

Optional:

- `is_default_disk` (Boolean) Whether this is the default disk. At most one attachment can be. Defaults to false.


<a id="nestedatt--pull_request"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pull_request`

Read-Only:

- `draft` (Boolean) Whether the pull request is a draft.
- `number` (Number) Pull request number.
- `source_branch` (String) Branch the pull request merges from.
- `status` (String) open, closed or merged.
- `target_branch` (String) Branch the pull request merges into.
- `title` (String) Pull request title.
- `url` (String) Pull request URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravel_cloud_environment.example "{environment_id}"
```
